review_description: ACS Solar were great.  Quote received promptly after in-depth discussion regarding our electricity needs.  Installers were punctual, polite, knowledgeable, efficient, and took good care with the installation.  Very tidy boys, did not leave a mess anywhere.Handover was excellent, very informative and well presented.   Software app well explained.
